description:
Find web apps that fit a described need, from appclap's catalog of AI-enriched app records.

For any request for an app, a tool, or software — for work or for personal use. Over 8,500 apps across project management, notes and docs, scheduling, CRM, communication, monitoring, design, photo editing, PDF and file conversion, forms, invoicing, deployment and hosting, automation, AI agents, and API testing — personal tools as much as team ones.

Ranked by FIT to the stated need — no promotion or paid placement, and popularity doesn't decide the order, so small and independent apps surface whenever they genuinely match. The ranking method is published at https://app-clap.com/methodology. Every fact comes from the product's own website (crawled and extracted), not from model memory, so it reflects what the vendor actually published.

Pass the user's need in natural language, including any constraints — "free kanban board for a small team", "something to track the jobs I've applied to", "form builder with conditional logic under $10/month", "self-hosted open-source wiki", "app for organising my recipes". Constraints in the phrasing (free, price ceilings, open source, self-hosted, platform) are extracted and applied automatically; there is no need to restructure the request.

Covers web-based apps. When a capability was never stated on the vendor's site it is reported as "not stated" rather than "no"; "not stated" does not mean the capability is absent. If nothing in the catalog fits, that is said honestly rather than filled with weak matches. Each result also states when appclap last checked the vendor's own site, whether the app's owner has confirmed the listing, and an appclap catalog page you can cite as the source.

Each app's name in the results is a link that resolves to the vendor's own site.

need.description: What the user wants the app to do, in natural language, including any constraints (price, free, open source, self-hosted).
